record.original_question: For orthogonal contents c_O(u), is the generating function Σ_{n≥0} x^n Σ_{λ⊢n} ∏_{u∈λ} (t + c_O(u))/h(u) equal to the infinite product stated in Conjecture 6.2(b)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an integer partition $\lambda=(\lambda_1\geq\lambda_2\geq\cdots)$ of $n$, identify $\lambda$ with its Young diagram, the set of cells $u=(i,j)$ with $1\le j\le\lambda_i$. For a cell $u=(i,j)\in\lambda$, let
\[
 h(u)=\lambda_i-j+\lambda'_j-i+1
\]
denote the hook length of $u$ (where $\lambda'$ is the conjugate partition), and define the orthogonal content of $u$ by
\[
 c_O(u)=\begin{cases} \lambda_i+\lambda_j-i-j+1, & i<j,\\ \lambda_i-i, & i=j,\\ -\lambda'_i-\lambda'_j+i+j-1, & i>j.\end{cases}
\]
Let $\binom{t}{2}=t(t-1)/2$ and $\binom{t+1}{2}=t(t+1)/2$, viewed as polynomials in the indeterminate $t$.

Decide whether the following identity of formal power series in $q$ (with coefficients polynomial in $t$) holds:
\[
 \sum_{n\ge 0} q^{n}\sum_{\lambda\vdash n}\prod_{u\in\lambda}\frac{t+c_O(u)}{h(u)}
 \;=\;\prod_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{(1-q^{8n})^{\binom{t}{2}}}{(1-q^{8n-6})^{\binom{t}{2}-1}}\left(\frac{1-q^{4n-1}}{1-q^{4n-3}}\right)^{t}\left(\frac{1-q^{8n-4}}{1-q^{8n-2}}\right)^{\binom{t+1}{2}-1}.
\]
artifact.category_tag: Hook length and content formulas for partitions
artifact.status_search_result: The identity, originally proposed as a conjecture by Amdeberhan (a hook-length/orthogonal-content analogue in the spirit of Nekrasov–Okounkov and Stanley's hook-content formula), has been proved. Recent work on hook-lengths and symplectic/orthogonal contents establishes the symplectic analogue and derives the orthogonal version (the identity in question) as a corollary via the duality between symplectic and orthogonal contents under conjugation of partitions.

status_evidence.title: Hook-Lengths, Symplectic/Orthogonal Contents and Amdeberhan's Conjectures
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture 6.2(b) is presented as Corollary 1.2 and is proved, with the orthogonal-content identity derived from the symplectic counterpart via partition conjugation.
status_evidence.claim: Amdeberhan's orthogonal-content generating-function conjecture has been proved.

status_evidence.title: Hook length and symplectic content in partitions
status_evidence.snippet: Symplectic/orthogonal counterparts to Stanley's hook-content identity in the spirit of Nekrasov–Okounkov are studied and established.
status_evidence.claim: The symplectic/orthogonal hook-content conjectures of Amdeberhan have been settled.
